name: --check
purpose: generate.py (the facts): writes nothing, and fails when a generated file on disk is stale; every commit's check passes it.

name: --config
purpose: Launcher and runner: a launch file, plain JSON with an "about" line. The runner's (port/moderngekko/src/switches.cpp; protocol/formats.md section 2) holds every setting of a game's start: the race or the replay, the bundle, and the test settings in its "debug" part; the launcher writes one for each game it starts. The launcher's own (net/src/Launcher.Core/Files/LaunchConfig.cs) names the launcher's test settings in its "debug" object, and hands "autopilot", "testLagMs" and "game" on to its games. Without a "debug" part every test setting is off; a member a reader does not know is refused. Two test settings are outside "debug" (the latency work's; protocol/formats.md section 2, "The latency test settings"): the runner's "present" ("console" or "copy": when a picture goes to the screen) and a race's "delay" below 2, which the launcher writes from its settings file's "present" and "inputDelay" (0, 1 or 2, never more; net/src/Launcher.Core/Settings.cs); each is named in the game's log when on.

name: --controllers
purpose: Runner: USER_FOLDER; no game is started: the controller helper the launcher's Controller page talks to in lines of JSON (protocol/formats.md section 4). It reads the settings, writes none, and ends when its input closes.

name: --dol
purpose: Image build: the stock executable (main.dol). With --rel, every replaced word is read from the game and the bundle is complete; build.sh passes both.

name: --fzgx-log
purpose: A file for the runner's standard output and error, for a game started with no console; the 19 runs before are kept (runner.1.log to runner.19.log). The adapter's options are this one, --config FILE (the launch file: protocol/formats.md section 2) and --controllers USER_FOLDER (the controller helper, the one start without a launch file: formats.md section 4).

name: --native
purpose: netframe.py: the frame routine in the mod image's native form; an argument after it is the file FZGX_CLEAN_REL names. modbuild.py passes both on from its environment.

name: --params
purpose: Image routines (direct.py, seats.py, setup.py): the routine reads its race from the race block instead of from its arguments; build.py and fork_bundle.py pass it.

name: --parts
purpose: standin.py: prints the seat routines and the installer's offsets as JSON, for the mod image; modbuild.py passes it.

name: --rel
purpose: Image build: main.rel as the disc has it, unpacked (not linked). It goes with --dol.

name: --replay-info
purpose: Runner: FILE; no game is started: what a replay file holds (its version, seats, steps, header and results) printed as one JSON object, read by the generated reader (protocol/replay.toml; fzgx/replay_info.h); status 1 for a file that is no replay.

name: --say
purpose: tools.py: the Windows build tools found, said for a person (found and MISSING lines, cmake's and ninja's versions); port/setup/setup.sh runs it.

name: --shell
purpose: tools.py: the Windows build tools found, as NAME='value' lines for the shell (port/setup/lib.sh find_tools), one line on standard error for each missing.

name: --value
purpose: generate.py (the facts): NAME, prints one value, for shell scripts. Only its own test passes it.

name: DOLRECOMP_BUDGET_CYCLES
purpose: runtime: the check at calls and loop heads reads CPUState.cycle_budget instead of the constant 256.

name: DOLRECOMP_CALL_COUNTERS
purpose: registers: a function body takes the cycle count and the budget guard as arguments and returns both.

name: DOLRECOMP_CLOSED_DEBUG
purpose: Prints every closed call edge found while the closed set is computed.

name: DOLRECOMP_CLOSED_DEFER
purpose: 1: closed bodies do not leave when the cycle budget is spent or the guest enables interrupts.

name: DOLRECOMP_CLOSED_EXCLUDE
purpose: Hex addresses of functions that never get a closed body (the GPU wait, the OS idle loop).

name: DOLRECOMP_CLOSED_ROOTS
purpose: Addresses, or all: the listed functions and what they reach get a second, closed body.

name: DOLRECOMP_CODEGEN_REV
purpose: Any text: changes no code, it only keys the object cache.

name: DOLRECOMP_COUNT
purpose: 1 (analysis builds): the module counts every straight run of guest code it enters, host floating-point mode loads, indirect calls, accesses the runtime serves and where accesses point; for the census. Off: nothing is counted.

name: DOLRECOMP_CYCLES
purpose: deferred: a straight-line run's cycle cost is summed at compile time and added where the counter is read.

name: DOLRECOMP_ENTRY_CHECK
purpose: off: leaves out the test of a body's entry flag (to measure its cost).

name: DOLRECOMP_ENTRY_LOADS
purpose: split: a call's entry and a resume's entry each load the registers on their own path.

name: DOLRECOMP_ENTRY_QUERY
purpose: off: an ordinary body does not ask the runtime at its entry whether a host call hook wants the address.

name: DOLRECOMP_FMA
purpose: hw: functions with a fused multiply-add are compiled with the host's FMA instructions instead of fma() calls.

name: DOLRECOMP_FMA_EARLY
purpose: 1: shows the host's fma feature to the IR optimizer; reproduces the case that was no longer bit-exact.

name: DOLRECOMP_FPRF
purpose: lazy: a pending FPRF is written to FPSCR only where the state can be observed.

name: DOLRECOMP_FPSCR
purpose: inline: mtfsb0/mtfsb1 on control bits and the update after an FPSCR write are emitted inline.

name: DOLRECOMP_GATHER_PIPE
purpose: inline: a store to the write-gather pipe's page appends at the host's pipe pointer, as Dolphin's JITs do.

name: DOLRECOMP_HOST_FEATURES
purpose: An LLVM feature string (the x86-64-v3 set): the host's newer instructions, attached after the optimiser has run, so that only code generation sees them. A module built with it crashes on a processor without them. Unset: the baseline's instructions.

name: DOLRECOMP_HOST_TUNE
purpose: An LLVM processor name to tune code generation for (x86-64-v3: generic for that level; never one processor alone). It changes instruction choice and scheduling, never values. Unset: generic tuning.

name: DOLRECOMP_INDIRECT_CALL_EXITS
purpose: Hex call sites that keep leaving generated code, for instrumentation that watches dispatches.

name: DOLRECOMP_INDIRECT_CALLS
purpose: native: bctrl/blrl look the target up in the module's tables and call it inside generated code.

name: DOLRECOMP_INDIRECT_GUARDS
purpose: site:target+target,... (hex): at a listed bctrl or blrl the target is first compared with the listed addresses, and a match is called as a direct call would be, without the table lookup. Unset: every indirect call takes the lookup.

name: DOLRECOMP_INLINE_CALLEES
purpose: N: callees of at most N guest instructions are compiled into the caller's chunk, so LLVM can inline them.

name: DOLRECOMP_INLINE_CLOSED
purpose: 1, with DOLRECOMP_INLINE_CALLEES: a small callee of the closed set is handed to its caller's chunk as its closed body, so that a closed caller can have it expanded in place. Off: an imported callee comes as its ordinary body only.

name: DOLRECOMP_INLINE_DEPTH
purpose: 1 to 24: how many calls deep small callees are imported into a chunk (the register save and restore helpers are chains of up to eighteen one-instruction functions), with up to 32 imports a chunk. Unset: three deep, 16 imports.

name: DOLRECOMP_LLVM_ONLY
purpose: Addresses: emits only the chunks that hold them, for inspecting generated code; not a linkable module.

name: DOLRECOMP_LLVM_TARGET
purpose: The LLVM backend's target triple.

name: DOLRECOMP_LLVM_WRITE_JOURNAL
purpose: purpose not recorded

name: DOLRECOMP_MEM2_BASE
purpose: Moves the second direct-memory window; 0xA0000000 for GameCube builds, where it covers the locked cache.

name: DOLRECOMP_MEM2_TRACK
purpose: 1: before every access through the second window the module reads the window's last eight bytes as a host pointer and calls the record it names when it is not null (the lanes' locked-cache record; branch feat/machine-lanes). Off: nothing emitted.

name: DOLRECOMP_MEM_TRACE
purpose: 1 (analysis builds): every guest load and store first reports to fz_trace.

name: DOLRECOMP_OPT_BISECT
purpose: n: LLVM's pass gate stops the optimizer after its n-th pass, to find the pass that breaks exactness.

name: DOLRECOMP_PAIRED_FP
purpose: jit64: the paired-single path follows Dolphin's Jit64 (rounding, tie correction, fix-ups).

name: DOLRECOMP_PARTITION_AT
purpose: Hex addresses that start a function of their own: code other functions branch into the middle of becomes a function, and the branch a tail call that can reach a closed body. Unset: the functions the recompiler finds.

name: DOLRECOMP_PRESERVE_ALL_VZEROUPPER
purpose: off: the rare-path helpers with the preserve_all convention are compiled without LLVM's automatic vzeroupper, which zeroes register halves their caller keeps. Needed before the optimiser may see AVX; proven on one chunk only.

name: DOLRECOMP_PRESERVE_NONE
purpose: 1: guest functions use preserve_none, so small hot ones do not save and restore registers.

name: DOLRECOMP_PS_MADD
purpose: guarded: the packed single fused multiply-add is kept only where both lanes' results are normal numbers.

name: DOLRECOMP_PSQ_GQR
purpose: index:hex value pairs: the value the title keeps in a GQR; quantized loads and stores are emitted for it.

name: DOLRECOMP_RESERVATION
purpose: stwcx-only: ordinary stores no longer clear the lwarx reservation.

name: DOLRECOMP_SCALAR_FP
purpose: inline: scalar floating point is emitted inline, the way Jit64 does it, instead of ppc_* helper calls.

name: DOLRECOMP_SINGLE_FP
purpose: track: single-precision views of FP registers are carried from instruction to instruction and from one straight run to the next; scalar single arithmetic on them is computed in single. Off in the released list.

name: DOLRECOMP_SINGLE_FP_STATS
purpose: 1: prints the single-precision tracking's figures per body.

name: DOLRECOMP_SINGLE_MATH
purpose: float: single-precision scalar arithmetic is computed on single views when every input has one.

name: DOLRECOMP_STATE_ALIAS
purpose: scoped: loads of guest registers carry scoped-noalias metadata, so LLVM keeps values across runtime calls.

name: DOLRECOMP_STATE_LAZY
purpose: regions (closed bodies, with DOLRECOMP_STATE_SYNC=changed): a changed register is not stored at a run's end when the next run of the same function takes it over; the store moves, none is dropped. Measured: exact, no gain; off.

name: DOLRECOMP_STATE_SYNC
purpose: changed: only the guest registers a run of code changed are written back.

name: DOLRECOMP_UNMAPPED_READS
purpose: first-last (hex, inclusive): a load that misses both memory windows and lies in the range answers zero in generated code, as the runtime does for an address nothing maps. Stores are not touched. Unset: the runtime answers.

name: FZGX_AXLOG
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.voiceLog"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. A file: every AX voice's parameter block before each audio frame is mixed, for comparing two runs voice by voice.

name: FZGX_CENSUS
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.census"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 1: the probe's census of what leaves generated code while a physics task runs (dispatches, hardware accesses, exceptions); off so that timing runs do not pay.

name: FZGX_CLEAN_REL
purpose: A file: main.rel as the stock game has it in memory, for building the mod image's native form.

name: FZGX_CORE_TESTS_CACHE
purpose: Where the core's built test program is kept between runs (default ~/.cache/fzgx-core-tests), under a hash of everything it is built from: the tests run every time, the compile only when that hash is new. A folder that cannot be made: nothing is kept.

name: FZGX_DUALCORE
purpose: 1 or 0: forces the GPU onto its own thread or onto the CPU thread, in a start with no launch file, which the port's runner refuses (build 19's gate runs have a launch file). With a launch file it is not read: the adapter decides (the launch file's "debug.singleCore").

name: FZGX_DUMP_FIELDS
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.dumpFields"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. Fields N,M,...: main.rel's .data and .bss at those fields go to <probe>.<N>.bin.

name: FZGX_DUMP_RAM
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.dumpRam"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. With FZGX_DUMP_FIELDS: the whole RAM is written too, to <probe>.<N>.ram.

name: FZGX_GATHER_INLINE
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.noGatherInline"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 0: every write-gather pipe write stays on the hook, for comparisons.

name: FZGX_ICACHE_FAST
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.noIcacheFast"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 0: the old instruction-cache invalidation path, for comparisons.

name: FZGX_IDLE_PCS
purpose: Guest addresses whose waits the core counts as idle time; in a start with a launch file the port's runner sets the game's three, whatever the environment held. (given to the emulator as a setting of the run, Common/RunSettings.h; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file)

name: FZGX_KEEP_HOSTCALL
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.keepHostCall"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. Keeps the mod manager's host-call checks at every dispatch although no mod is loaded.

name: FZGX_L1_AS_MEM2
purpose: Shows the locked L1 cache through the module's second direct window (with DOLRECOMP_MEM2_BASE); in a start with a launch file the port's runner sets it, whatever the environment held. (given to the emulator as a setting of the run, Common/RunSettings.h; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file)

name: FZGX_NATIVE
purpose: 1: the generators build the mod image's native form (default: the fork's, byte for byte as before).

name: FZGX_NO_BUSYWAIT
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.noBusyWait"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 1: turns the core's analyzer-based busy-wait detection off.

name: FZGX_NO_HOOK_FLUSH
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.noHookFlush"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 1: turns FlushDispatchCharge off, for bisecting.

name: FZGX_PACE_LOG
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.paceLog"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. A file: the pacing log, one record per event in microseconds of one clock (read with port/gates/reports/pace-report.py).

name: FZGX_PAD
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.pad"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. neutral, or FIELD:BUTTONS_HEX[:SX:SY[:CX:CY]],...: port 0 is driven by this script only, so inputs land on exact fields.

name: FZGX_POKE8
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.poke"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. ADDR:VALUE[@FROM-TO],...: bytes written to main RAM at every field or at the fields given; for demonstration clips.

name: FZGX_POKE8_TASK
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.pokeTask"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. The FZGX_POKE8 list, written at the start of every per-machine task call instead (the scenes use it to hand the machine to the game's AI).

name: FZGX_POKE8_TASK_BY
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.pokeTaskByFrame"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. frame: FZGX_POKE8_TASK's FROM-TO are race frames instead of fields of the run.

name: FZGX_PROBE
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.probe"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. A CSV path: turns the probe on (a line of hashes and timings per field), for comparing the native core with the JIT.

name: FZGX_PROBE_HASH
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.probeNoHash"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 0: the probe leaves its hashes out.

name: FZGX_REINTERPRET_REUSE
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.noReinterpretReuse"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 0: brings back the texture cache's fault with a reinterpreted frame-buffer copy (the freeze), for tests.

name: FZGX_REPLAY_ROUND_TRIP
purpose: A file naming replay files, one path a line: the core tests write each back through the generated writer's parts and fail when one differs from its file by a byte (the proof, on real recordings, that the generated writer writes what the hand-written one did). Unset: only the shared samples.

name: FZGX_SAMPLE
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.sample"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. A file: sampling profiler of the CPU thread, one instruction pointer about every millisecond while a race runs.

name: FZGX_SAMPLE_PHYSICS
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.samplePhysics"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. With FZGX_SAMPLE: samples only inside the three physics tasks.

name: FZGX_SAMPLE_TASKS
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.sampleTasks"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. With FZGX_SAMPLE: samples only inside a timed task call.

name: FZGX_SLOW_LOG
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.noSlowLog" or "debug.slowLogEverySecond"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 0: turns off the log line for every slow second; all: writes every second.

name: FZGX_TASKDUMP
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.taskDumps"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. Race frames N,M,...: full RAM at the first task call of each, to <probe>.task<N>.ram.

name: FZGX_TASKLIST
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.taskList"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 1: every function the task runner calls, with its call count, printed at shutdown.

name: FZGX_TASKPROF
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.taskTimers"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. Turns on the probe's timers around the per-machine task calls (and its hooks under the JIT).

name: FZGX_TEST_TIME_LIMIT_SECONDS
purpose: A test's time limit in seconds instead of the built-in one, to see the limit at work.

name: FZGX_TIMEBASE_BY_CHARGE
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.timebaseByCharge"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 1: the time-base fault as it was (the charge counted as ticks), to compare with a player's report.

name: FZGX_TRACE
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.accessTrace" or "debug.accessTraceNoInterrupts"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 1 (a module built with DOLRECOMP_MEM_TRACE=1): which blocks of RAM each physics call reads and writes; noirq leaves the interrupt handler's out.

name: FZGX_USER_GAME_SETTINGS
purpose: No variable anyone sets: the name under which the adapter tells the emulator that the launch file's "debug.cheats" is on, so that the user folder's settings file for the game (GameSettings/GFZE01.ini: settings, codes, every-frame patches) is read, the system folder's file for the game (Sys/GameSettings beside the runner) gives its every-frame patches and codes, and the user folder's map file is loaded. Without it, in a start with a launch file, the user's file is not read, cheats are off, and no file of either folder patches the game.

name: FZGX_WINDOW_CONTROLS
purpose: No variable anyone sets: the name under which the adapter tells the emulator that the launch file's "debug.windowControls" is on, so that the game window has its controls that change the game (Save State and Load State in the File menu and on F1, Pause, fast forward while Space is held). Without it, in a start with a launch file, the window has none of them.

name: FZGX_WINDOW_NOACTIVATE
purpose: With a launch file only by its key "debug.windowNoActivate"; the variable is read only in a start with no launch file. 1: the game's window is shown without taking the keyboard from whoever is at the PC.

name: FZGX_WORK
purpose: The work folder the image tests build the complete bundle in (default: the folder port/setup/work-folder.env names).

name: MODERNGEKKO_*
purpose: The emulator's own names (ModernGekko), read by its code, not ours: MODERNGEKKO_STATICRECOMP=0 runs the game on the emulator's compiler in place of the native module, and with a launch file only its debug part sets it (jit); the others are definitions its build takes (MODERNGEKKO_FZGX_PORT_DIR, port.cmake).

name: PORT_WORK
purpose: The port's work folder (default: the folder port/setup/work-folder.env names; port/setup/setup.sh makes one): every script of port/build, port/gates and port/setup works in it.

name: STATICRECOMP_*
purpose: The recompiler runtime's own test variables (lockstep, traces, fallback ranges), read by the runtime, not by our code. With a launch file they are set from its debug part only (EMULATOR_KEYS) and the environment is not read.
